subject: AWS Marketplace metering activation & contract ops handoff
messages:
From: emily.harper@amazon.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:04:00 +0000
Subject: AWS Marketplace activation timeline / metering mapping for Acme Analytics

Hi Marissa,

Quick follow up from our enablement sync — Acme Analytics is ready to move the SaaS contract to fulfillment but the metering mapping needs final sign-off before activation. They raised two items:

- Confirm how seat vs. consumption SKUs are reported (they expect separate entitlement lines per product).
- Whether trial periods will appear as zero-usage entitlements or be omitted from metering reports.

Attached is a draft metering_mapping_v2.csv from their engineering team and a redline of the SaaS agreement. Can your contracts/ops team confirm the billing reconciliation flow and expected webhook payload?

AWS asked whether we can go live in the week of Nov 24th (their upcoming co-sell target). Can Redwood commit to the metering activation and DocuSign routing by then?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call if helpful.

Emily Harper
Partner Success, AWS Marketplace

Attachments: metering_mapping_v2.csv, Acme_SaaS_Contract_Redline.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: emily.harper@amazon.com, jordan.smith@acmeanalytics.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace activation timeline / metering mapping for Acme Analytics

Emily — thanks for the clear notes. Looping in Soojin (sales ops) and Aditya (platform integrator) to confirm the technical and contract pieces. High level:

- Metering model: Redwood can emit separate SKU lines for seat and consumption; we will map those to entitlement IDs during fulfillment. The attached CSV looks mostly aligned; I flagged two SKU name mismatches (rows 4 and 9) that will need to match the contract.
- Trials: by default trials create an entitlement with a zero-usage flag so they’re visible in the entitlement feed. If Acme prefers trials to be omitted we can toggle that per-tenant in the fulfillment config.

On timing — week of Nov 24th is tight but possible if we get: (1) signed contract by Nov 18, (2) final metering CSV confirmed by Nov 17, and (3) a short test webhook payload validated against their ingestion sandbox. Can Acme commit to those dates?

Proposed next steps:
1) Aditya runs a quick compatibility pass on the CSV and returns a patched mapping by EOD Nov 14.
2) Soojin to own DocuSign routing and clarify billing entity/PO terms with Jordan.
3) Emily to confirm AWS co-sell milestone timing and any marketplace listing gating items.

If everyone agrees I’ll open a shared folder and drop the signed-agreement template for their legal to review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: Redwood-SaaS-Agreement-Draft-v3.pdf
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, emily.harper@amazon.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, jordan.smith@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 15:06:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace activation timeline / metering mapping for Acme Analytics

Thanks Marissa — I can pick up DocuSign and procurement coordination. Jordan, a couple items I need to confirm from Acme legal/procurement: billing entity name, remit-to address, and whether they require a purchase order number at activation. Also please confirm the exact billing cadence you want recorded in the marketplace listing (monthly in arrears vs. pro-rated first invoice).

If they require a PO number we need it before we trigger fulfillment; otherwise we can proceed with execution and add PO retrospectively for invoicing (depends on your internal finance policy).

I’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope and share a contract view link for sign-off by Nov 17 so we can hit the Nov 18 signature target Marissa mentioned.

—Soji
Soji (Soojin) Lee
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, emily.harper@amazon.com
Cc: jordan.smith@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 08:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace activation timeline / metering mapping for Acme Analytics

Quick technical check-in from my side after validating the CSV against our fulfillment mapping engine:

- I normalized the two mismatched SKUs and added an idempotency key column for their ingestion pipeline. Updated CSV attached as metering_mapping_v2_patched.csv.
- Webhook payload: sample schema attached (sample_webhook_payload.json) — the important fields for reconciliation are entitlement_id, usage_quantity, timestamp, and meter_id. We will include a buyer_id field to tie back to Acme tenant id.
- Sandbox test: I can run a short end-to-end test if Acme can provide a sandbox API key and a small test account. That will confirm our fulfillment lambda writes the entitlement correctly into the marketplace ledger.

I’m good to run the test as early as Nov 17 if we have the sandbox creds. Otherwise we can bench test and still keep Nov 24th as a soft target but with higher risk.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: metering_mapping_v2_patched.csv, sample_webhook_payload.json
From: jordan.smith@acmeanalytics.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: emily.harper@amazon.com
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace activation timeline / metering mapping for Acme Analytics

Appreciate the quick turn. We can meet the dates below:

- Final metering CSV: Nov 17 by EOD (we will confirm the two SKU names and provide sandbox API key).
- Contract signature: Nov 18 (we’ll route PO if required; Finance prefers PO up front but can accept retrospective).
- Sandbox test window: Nov 17–18 (Aditya, I will DM the sandbox key after the internal IT whitelist).

I’ve reviewed the patched CSV — looks good at a glance. I also confirmed Finance wants monthly invoicing in arrears and will provide a PO for the first month.

I’ll complete the DocuSign signing once Soojin sends the envelope and will echo to Emily for the co-sell milestone. Thanks everyone — let’s keep the short call optional unless blockers pop up.

Jordan Smith
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

Forwarded attachments referenced: metering_mapping_v2_patched.csv, sample_webhook_payload.json
